messages:
Maya Chen: Quick kickoff — Hi team, starting onboarding for client Evergro today. Goal: enable 2 pilot routes, get integration + eval criteria in 2 weeks. Stakeholders: David (AE), Sofia (SE), Jenna (CS Ops), Liam (Eng). I'll run weekly 30m standups Tue 10am PT. Thoughts?
David Park: Thanks Maya. Evergro primary contacts: @sarah_w (product), @raj_ops (infra). Product wants feature parity with current LLM endpoint and clear cost targets.
Sofia Ramos: Can we confirm infra access? Need VPC peering + sample requests to validate batching. Who owns creds?
Liam O'Neill: I can take the peering task. @david please get infra contact. Also need expected traffic profile (qps, sequence lengths).
Jenna Li: I'll own enablement: scheduling training, creating runbook, and capturing feedback. Drafting a 2-week enablement cadence doc — link: https://redwood.app/notes/evr-onboard (placeholder).
Maya Chen: Success criteria (proposed): 1) integration test pass rate >= 95% across 3 scenarios; 2) avg generation latency <= 250ms p50; 3) cost per 1k tokens within 20% of baseline; 4) team trained & runbook accepted. Agree?
David Park: Agree. Add renewal risk note: if pilot misses latency/cost targets, likely delayed purchase decision. Flagging as medium.
Sofia Ramos: For tests I need sample prompt set and expected outputs. Can we use the "chat-evals-v1" repo? @Maya can you add?
Maya Chen: Done, added prompts to the shared drive. Also uploading a tiny prompt set:
```json
{"scenario":"search-assist","examples":[{"input":"Find latest invoice for account 4432","expected_contains":"Invoice 4432"}]}
```
Liam O'Neill: For infra timeline: I'll request peering today, estimate 48-72h for setup. We'll do a smoke test immediately after.
OnboardBot: Reminder: kickoff survey to client sent (link). Survey responses pending.
Jenna Li: I'll schedule two 45m enablement sessions next Wed/Thu for product and infra. Also will capture feedback via a short form after session.
Maya Chen: Next steps: David to confirm client infra contacts (by EOD), Liam to start peering, Sofia to prepare test harness, Jenna to schedule enablement, I'll send calendar invites and the kickoff doc. Weekly sync Tue 10am PT. :thumbsup:
David Park: Confirmed — I'll ping @raj_ops and cc you all.
Sofia Ramos: Adding a small checklist in case of SSO: need SAML metadata + SP entity ID.
Maya Chen: Noted. Thanks everyone. I'll post an updated checklist in the thread.
